overview: Two ways to describe how far something has moved — one counts every step, the other only cares where you ended up.
genZNote: Physics really said direction matters. Pain.

aspects.label: Definition
aspects.valueA: Total path length covered during motion.
aspects.valueB: Shortest straight-line change in position from start to end.

aspects.label: Depends on Path?
aspects.valueA: Yes — the actual route taken matters.
aspects.valueB: No — only initial and final positions matter.

aspects.label: Can It Be Zero?
aspects.valueA: Only if the object never moves.
aspects.valueB: Yes, whenever the object returns to its starting point.
